I added an "Agenda" item to the portal menu, and the form is valid.

The item is a standard page of type "Catalogue d'événements" (`subtype: event-catalog`) with the label "Agenda". I chose this over "Page d'événements", which points at one specific events page, because the catalogue is the page that lists all published events automatically.

The menu now has three items: Accueil, Catalogue de données, and Agenda. The Agenda item is the last one. I did not save the draft or set an icon or "open in new tab" option.
